_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_combat_damage_trigger_doubling.py. t_fx_felix is Felix Five-Boots' doubling line on a 0/4 body that stays home. t_fx_any_damage hears every damage to a player, combat or not, so the noncombat half can be asserted; t_fx_hit_me hears creatures hitting its controller, for the two 'you control' halves; t_fx_brawler hears damage dealt to itself, the creature half. The per-connection, per-source, planeswalker and batch listeners are reused from their own test files.
